sn35.146:1.1: navapurāṇāni bhikkhave kammāni desissāmi kammanirodhañca kammanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ
sn35.146:1.4: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave purāṇakammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedaniyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ …pe…
sn35.146:1.5: jivhā purāṇakammā abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā vedaniyā daṭṭhabbā …pe…
sn35.146:1.6: mano purāṇakammo abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito vedaniyo daṭṭhabbo.
sn35.146:1.9: yaṃ kho bhikkhave etarahi kammaṃ karoti kāyena vācāya manasā.
sn35.146:1.12: yo kho bhikkhave kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ manokammassa nirodhā vimuttiṃ phusati.
sn35.146:1.16: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sn35.146:1.18: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā purāṇakammaṃ desitaṃ navakammaṃ desito kammanirodho desitā kammanirodhagāminī paṭipadā.
sn35.146:1.19: yaṃ kho bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya kataṃ kho mayā.
sn35.146:1.20: etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. byāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādattha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
